title: Select the predecessor final test after its x2 artifacts exist
failure_signature: The v645-v6 x1-stage test was run against Orin's completed x2 packet and correctly failed its no-x2-files assertion.
trigger_preconditions: both x1-only and final scoped tests exist
candidate_workaround: Match a validation entrypoint to the artifact stage it was designed to test.
recurrence_guard: Before invoking inherited tests, inspect whether the entrypoint asserts x1-only absence or final-packet presence.
rollback: Assign no credit to the stage-mismatched run and preserve both the test and completed predecessor artifacts.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
